Therefore, only two teams would be relegated from the [[2022–23 Saudi Pro League]] instead of the usual three, and four teams would be promoted from the [[2022–23 Saudi First Division League]].{{cite web |title=رسمياً.. زيادة عدد أندية الدوري السعودي والأجانب |url=https://www.alarabiya.net/sport/saudi-sport/2022/04/14/%D8%B1%D8%B3%D9%85%D9%8A%D8%A7%D9%8B-%D8%B2%D9%8A%D8%A7%D8%AF%D8%A9-%D8%B9%D8%AF%D8%AF-%D8%A3%D9%86%D8%AF%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AF%D9%88%D8%B1%D9%8A-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B3%D8%B9%D9%88%D8%AF%D9%8A-%D9%88%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A3%D8%AC%D8%A7%D9%86%D8%A8}} In June 2023, the [[Public Investment Fund]] acquired a 75% stake in [[Al-Ahli Saudi FC|Al-Ahli]], [[Al Hilal SFC|Al-Hilal]], [[Al-Ittihad Club (Jeddah)|Al-Ittihad]] and [[Al Nassr FC|Al-Nassr]].{{Cite web|url=https://www.sportspromedia.com/news/saudi-pro-league-pif-al-nassr-hilal-ittihad-ahli-takeover-privatisation-aramco-neom/?zephr_sso_ott=xSdvk1|work=Sports Pro Media|title=PIF takes ownership of four Saudi Pro League clubs as Aramco, Neom, Driyah Gate and Royal Commission for Al-Ula also buy in|date=6 June 2023|accessdate=24 July 2023}} ===Record=== This season had the highest attendance in the SPL history, with 2,496,510 fans attending the matches. ==Teams== {{Location map+ |Saudi Arabia |width=440 |float=right |caption=Locations of teams in the 2023–24 Saudi Pro League |places= {{Location map~ |Saudi Arabia |lat=18.216944 |long=42.505278 |label=[[Abha Club|Abha]]|position=bottom}} {{Location map~ |Saudi Arabia |lat=21.54333 |long=39.17278 |label=[[Al-Ahli Saudi FC|Al-Ahli]]

18 teams competed in the league – the top 14 teams from the previous season and the 4 teams promoted from the [[2022–23 Saudi First Division League|FD League]]. ===Teams who were promoted to the Pro League=== On 5 May 2023, [[Al-Ahli Saudi FC|Al-Ahli]] became the first team to be promoted, following [[Al-Faisaly FC|Al-Faisaly]]'s 2–2 draw with [[Najran SC|Najran]].{{cite web |title=بعد 312 يوما.. الأهلي يعود |url=https://arriyadiyah.com/804804}} They were crowned champions following a 1–0 win against [[Al-Qadsiah FC|Al-Qadsiah]] on 23 May 2023.{{cite web |title=بعد صعوده لدوري روشن.. الأهلي بطلاً لدوري يلو لأندية الدرجة الأولى |date=23 May 2023 |url=https://sabq.org/sports/new8sgf1yp}} Al-Ahli played in the top flight of Saudi football after a season's absence and played in their 47th season in the top flight. The second club to be promoted was [[Al-Okhdood Club|Al-Okhdood]], who were promoted after Al-Faisaly's 2–2 draw with [[Jeddah Club|Jeddah]] on 15 May 2023.{{cite web |title=نادي الأخدود يصعد لأول مرة في تاريخه لدوري روشن للمحترفين |url=https://www.al-jazirah.com/2023/20230516/sp11.htm}} Al-Okhdood played in the top flight of Saudi football for the first time in history. Al-Okhdood became the 37th side to participate in the Saudi Pro League since its inception. The third club to be promoted was [[Al-Riyadh SC|Al-Riyadh]], who were promoted following a 1–0 home win against [[Al-Orobah FC|Al-Orobah]] on 16 May 2023.{{cite web |title=بعد 18 عاما.. "مدرسة الوسطى" بين الكبار |url=https://arriyadiyah.com/805945}} Al-Riyadh returned to the top flight for the first time since getting relegated in the [[2004–05 Saudi Premier League|2004–05 season]]. Al-Riyadh played in their 24th season in the top flight. The fourth and final club to be promoted was [[Al-Hazem F.C.|Al-Hazem]], who were promoted following a 3–2 win against [[Al-Sahel SC (Saudi Arabia)|Al-Sahel]] on 17 May 2023.{{cite web |title=الحزم يخطف بطاقة الصعود الأخيرة |url=https://arriyadiyah.com/805997}} Al-Hazem played in the top flight of Saudi football after a season's absence and played in their 10th season in the top flight. ===Teams who were relegated to the FD League=== [[Al-Batin FC|Al-Batin]] were the first club to be relegated, following a 1–0 defeat away to [[Al-Ittihad Club (Jeddah)|Al-Ittihad]] on 23 May 2023.{{cite web |title=الباطن.. 2023.. الحصيلة الأسوأ |url=https://arriyadiyah.com/806694/}} Al-Batin were relegated after three years in the top flight. [[Al-Adalah FC|Al-Adalah]] were the second and final club to be relegated, following a 2–0 home defeat to [[Al-Ettifaq FC|Al-Ettifaq]] on the final matchday.{{cite web |title=بعد 367 يوما.. العدالة يعود إلى "يلو" |url=https://arriyadiyah.com/807521/}} Al-Adalah were relegated after just one year in the top flight. ===Stadiums=== :Note: Table lists in alphabetical order. {| class="wikitable sortable" |- !
